narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On March 12, 2024, at approximately 0910 hours, Border Patrol Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered near Monroe, Michigan during roving patrol duties. Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] identified himself as a Border Patrol Agent and questioned the subject as to his citizenship. The subject stated that he is a citizen and national of Mexico and that he does not possess any immigration documents allowing him to be in or remain in the United States legally. The subject presented a Mexican consular identification card. Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] placed the subject under arrest at approximately 0910 hours.
ENTRY:
The subject stated that he came to the United States several years ago and has lived in Toledo, Ohio, since then.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
The subject was processed for a Notice to Appear and was served with a Warrant of Arrest.
